name: dsh-movie-market
description: DSH plugin: the Phase-7 plugins marketplace. Hosts the Source-Plugin-Runtime (SPR) supervisor that spawns every external skill/tool source as an OS-sandboxed MCP stdio child (systemd-run --user scope wrapping bubblewrap; docker optional), speaks MCP to it with @modelcontextprotocol/client, and provides the ctx.movieMarket service for tool lifecycle and skill search/download.
